elements.note: Two-span continuous beam, 4.50 + 4.50 m, drawn in elevation with section 5-5 through it. The 4.50 m spans match the toilet block's ก-ข and ข-ค grid spacing exactly, so B5 is the beam running in the letter direction on grid lines 1 and 2, continuous over grid ข.

warnings: RESOLVES the open question left on หน้า15_view2 (S-02 toilet block): B4, B5 and B6 are REINFORCED CONCRETE beams with full rebar, not steel members. That is why S-02's หมายเหตุ block -- which lists steel sections only -- omitted them. The toilet block is an RC structure while the main row building is a steel portal frame; the two buildings use different construction entirely.

This sheet gives the SPREAD-footing (แบบฐานแผ่) alternative for all four marks; S-04 (หน้า17) gives the PILE-footing (แบบตอกเข็ม) alternative for the same four marks. Which one is built depends on soil bearing capacity per รายการประกอบแบบ 4.1/4.2 on S-01. The two sets are NOT interchangeable data -- sizes and reinforcement differ substantially, e.g. F1 is 0.75x0.75 with 5+5ø12 as a pile cap but 0.90x0.90 with 6+6ø9 as a spread footing.

CORRECTION to a note written on หน้า17 (S-04): there, F1 and F3 share a single combined detail drawn as 'F1,F3'. On THIS sheet they are drawn separately and are NOT the same size -- F1 is 0.90x0.90 with 6+6ø9 and F3 is 1.00x1.00 with 6+6ø12. So the marks coincide only in the pile-footing option, not in general. Do not merge F1 and F3 across footing types.

Pedestal marks are printed here as 'C-1' and 'C-2' with a hyphen, while the footing plans on S-01 and the section callouts on S-04 write them as 'C1' and 'C2' without one. element_id is kept exactly as printed on each sheet per spec §8; a downstream join on element_id must normalise the hyphen. Both refer to the same two pedestals -- C-1 250x250 4ø15 and C-2 200x200 4ø12, each stated to run ฐานราก-หลังคา (footing to roof).

Column reinforcement is recorded under main_bar.all_faces rather than top/bottom: spec §6's top/bottom split describes a beam's tension/compression faces and does not apply to a square column section with 4 corner bars. This is a deliberate deviation, flagged here rather than forced into the beam shape.

B5's additional 2ø19 top bars over the intermediate support are recorded in additional_bars with their printed 1.15 m length, NOT merged into main_bar.top, because the elevation shows them stopping short rather than running the full length -- per spec §7 the leader and the drawn extent decide, and here the bar is visibly curtailed.
